verdict.rationale: Convex documents separate non-production environments. These include a dev deployment that the CLI pushes to and runs functions against, locally run deployments, and preview deployments. Its MCP server is blocked from production by default specifically to prevent accidental changes to production data, which directly serves AI-native sandbox testing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that dev and preview data stores are isolated from production, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox workflow.
